evidence.section: 2. Experimental

evidence.quote: A stepwise solution heat treatment at 1290 ◦ C/ 1 h + 1300 ◦ C/ 1 h + 1310 ◦ C/ 3 h + 1320 ◦ C/ 5 h + 1328 ◦ C/ 15 h, and then air cooling (A.C.), which was to diminish inter-dendritic eutectic microstructures and solidification segregation

evidence.section: 2. Experimental
evidence.quote: Subsequently, a two-stage ageing treatment was adopted and it was 1180 ◦ C/ 4 h (A.C.) + 870 ◦ C/ 24 h (A.C.). The primary ageing process is to obtain uniformly dispersed γ ′ phases, and the secondary ageing could adjust the cubic degree of γ ′ phases.

evidence.section: 5. Discussions
evidence.quote: The orientation changes in Fig. 3a indicates that the crystal orientation rotates from the [001]-[101] boundary towards the [001]-[111] boundary at the primary stage (from I to III), which is consistent with the orientation rotation law dominated by the {111} 〈 110 〉 slip system shown in Fig. 2a.

evidence.section: 5. Discussions
evidence.quote: The {111} 〈 110 〉 slip system dominates the rotation process at the primary stage, the {111} 〈 112 〉 single slip results in the orientation rotation at the secondary stage, and the {111} 〈 112 〉 conjugate double slip causes the rotation process at the tertiary stage.
